Once you have a basic understanding of programming concepts, you can then start learning Python by studying the official documentation of the Python language, which is available online at <https://docs.python.org/>.
In addition to studying the official documentation of the Python language, you should also consider practicing your Python skills by working on practical projects that involve using Python programming language.
